A standard marathon is **26.2 miles (42.195 kilometers)** long.

This distance was officially established at the **1908 London Olympics** and later standardized by the **International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF)** in 1921.

The origin of the 26.2-mile length comes from the 1908 London race, where the course was extended to ensure the finish line was in front of the royal box at Windsor Castle. The extra distance (from the original ~25 miles) became the new standard.
